user.title: Location
user.description: Pick the place you want climate values for. The circle is the search radius for nearby stations.

reconfigure.title: Move location
reconfigure.description: Pick the new place. Afterwards you confirm the surroundings and the stations again.

environment.title: Surroundings
environment.description: How is the area around this place built up? This decides which stations represent it best. The pre-selection comes from the Local Climate Zone map.

stations.title: Stations

map.title: Choose stations on the map
map.description: The map opens in a new window. If it does not, [open the map]({url}). After saving there, setup continues here automatically.

list.title: Stations
list.description:
{recommendation}

The recommendation is pre-selected. Planned API requests: {planned} per hour at an update interval of {interval} min (at most {budget}; the API limit of {api_limit} per hour applies per internet connection).

data.temperature_sensors: Stations for temperature and humidity (at most {max_stations})

data_description.temperature_sensors: One station is used as is, several are combined (median, outliers removed). The maximum follows from the API budget.
data_description.wind_sensor: Wind is not averaged; pick one station.

error.outside_coverage: There is no station within 10 km of this place.
error.over_budget: Too many API requests per hour. Select fewer stations or a longer update interval in the options.
error.unknown_station: One of the selected stations is unknown. Reload the page and try again.

abort.cannot_connect: The station list could not be loaded from api.smartmannheim.de. Try again later.

init.title: Stations and settings

data.temperature_sensors: Stations for temperature and humidity (at most {max_stations} at {interval} min)

data_description.temperature_sensors: One station is used as is, several are combined (median, outliers removed). The maximum follows from the API budget.
data_description.wind_sensor: Wind is not averaged; pick one station.
data_description.scan_interval: New values arrive every 10 minutes with 10-20 minutes delay.
data_description.dew_point_offset: Added to the dew point before humidity is calculated. The network tends to read too humid; -1.3 K matched the DWD station Mannheim in a 31-day comparison.

error.over_budget: Too many API requests per hour. Select fewer stations or a longer update interval.
error.unknown_station: One of the selected stations is unknown. Reload the page and try again.

abort.cannot_connect: The station list could not be loaded from api.smartmannheim.de. Try again later.

options.open_built: Open built-up area (detached or row houses, blocks with green space)
options.green: Green or open land (park, forest, fields, water)

options.nearest_fits: The nearest station **{station}** ({distance}) has the same surroundings and is used on its own.
options.nearest_too_far: The nearest station **{station}** is {distance} away. Recommended: the combination of {count} stations around you.
options.nearest_other_environment: The nearest station **{station}** ({distance}) has other surroundings ({environment}). Recommended: the combination of {count} stations, same surroundings first.

options.title: Choose stations
options.hint: Click a station to select or deselect it. Zoom in where stations are close together.
options.limit_reached: At most {max} stations fit the API budget. Deselect one first.
options.over_budget: This choice does not fit the API budget. Select fewer stations or no wind station.
options.budget: Updates every {interval} min · {requests} of {budget} API requests per hour
options.done: Saved. You can close this window, setup in Home Assistant continues automatically.
options.error: Saving failed ({error}). Restart the setup in Home Assistant.

no_recent_data.message: None of the selected stations delivered data in the last 40 minutes.

waiting_for_budget.message: The API request budget is used up for the moment. Retrying in {seconds} seconds.

station_list_unavailable.message: The station list could not be loaded from api.smartmannheim.de.

no_stations_available.message: None of the selected stations exists any more. Reconfigure the stations in the integration options.

station_offline.title: Station {station} sends no data
station_offline.description: The station {station} used by "{entry}" has not delivered data for 24 hours. The other selected stations are still used. If this continues, pick another station in the integration options.

station_removed.title: Station {station} no longer exists
station_removed.description: The API no longer knows the station {station} used by "{entry}". Pick another station in the integration options.
